proof_dependency_chain: Construct the local orbit relation using finite covers.
Show its quotient presheaf is separated and explicitly glue it to a sheaf Q.
Derive quotient local surjectivity and exact local orbit equality.
Construct D=E/Gamma and the canonical comparison E to H fiber-product_Q D.
Prove comparison locally surjective without global representatives.
Identify its injectivity precisely with testwise trivial stabilizer action.
Use the resulting isomorphism plus quotient universality to obtain the full category equivalence.
Apply the same local relation argument to nonrepresentable H_B to prove arbitrary base change.

Author-identified temptation: Equivariance alone is treated as descent data for the coarse quotient.
Author-identified temptation: Arbitrary base changes are assumed representable or assumed to reflect descendability.
Independent peer check: Finite-cover local orbit relation gives a separated presheaf; matching-family gluing gives a sheaf, local surjectivity and exact local orbit equality.
Independent peer check: The comparison E -> H fiber-product_Q E/Gamma is locally surjective without global representative choices.
Independent peer check: Trivial stabilizer action on every test object is exactly the missing injectivity condition; constant-gamma tests extend to local group elements.
Independent peer check: Quotient and pullback are mutually inverse on objects and all morphisms; uniqueness with chosen realization identifications is distinguished from automorphisms.
Independent peer check: For arbitrary nonrepresentable B over Q, H_B/Gamma is B; base-change classification and coordinate-reordering compatibility are correct.
Independent peer check: Dense integer orbit and point-invisible negation examples are valid and fully retain their stated hypotheses.
Independent peer check: V-valued sheaves and all gluing constructions have legal size; empty tests, T and base are covered.
